name: tilttek/sets
description: Sets for badges, collections and other gamification: versioned definitions, tiers, completion from what a holder owns, declared rewards and events, without granting anything.

suggest.symfony/console: For the tilttek:sets:deliver command, which tells again the completions whose event was not delivered
suggest.symfony/lock: To keep two workers consuming the delivery schedule from both sending its message
suggest.symfony/messenger: For the handler of the message that tells again the completions whose event was not delivered
suggest.symfony/scheduler: For the schedule that sends that message at an interval
